message: URGENT: The airline misplaced your clients' luggage on arrival! They are absolutely refusing to go out to their high-end evening arrangements wearing their airport clothes. How do you handle this?

choices.text: Send emergency funds to purchase high end local garments.
Tell them to wait for airline courier delivery

message: HOTEL ADVISORY: Due to clerical error, the booked lodging has double booked the clients room category. They are offering an immediate choice to resolve the conflict.

choices.text: Bribe the front desk manager for a VIP penthouse upgrade
Accept downgrade to standard quarters with a basic diner voucher

message: WEATHER ALERT: Severe localized storms have forced the cancellation of the planned outdoor activites! Your clients are sitting in the hotel lobby feeling thoroughly dissapointed.

choices.text: Secure last-minute tickets to an exclusive private indoor showcase.
Apologize and issue a standard local (maybe partial) refund.

message: MEDICAL: Your client reports a sudden bout of severe food poisoning from a questionable street food stand and cannot leave their room!

choices.text: Dispatch a private on-call hotel physician to prescribe fast acting treatment.
Advice them to rely on a local drugstore delivery service

message: TRANSIT ALARM: A sudden public transportation and taxi strike has completely paralyzed the city! Your clients are stranded at the central station.

choices.text: Hire a premium private executive driver who is bypass authorized.
Instruct them to sit tight at the station lounge and wait it out

message: FLIGHT ALERT: The airline has bumped your clients from their scheduled route due to overbooking! They are furious and stranded at the airport check-in desk.

choices.text: INstantly purchase seat upgrades on a rival premium carrier departing in 1 hour
File a formal complaint and make them wait for the standby flight in 6 hours

message: SECURITY INCIDENT: Your client had their professional camera bag swiped in a bustling city market! They are extremely stressed about losing their vacation photos.

choices.text: Purchase an identical high end replacement body from certified boutique nearby
Help them file an official police report for insurance later.

message: The clients were turned away from the airport VIP club lounge due to an unconfirmed booking confirmation reference number.

choices.text: Authorize an immediate wire payment for single use executive passes.
Advise them to utilise the regular boarding gate seating options
